# Derived variables
Computed (derived) scores for the battery, with the R-style formulas used to calculate them (`df` = the dataframe holding the raw variables).

## DEM — Demographics

- **Not present in the raw database** — Family Affluence scale
  ```r
  apply(cbind(df$DEM_08,df$DEM_09,df$DEM_10 ,df$DEM_11 ,df$DEM_12 ,df$DEM_17), 1, sum)
  ```

- **Not present in the raw database** — Generation status
  ```r
  GenStatus <- cbind(df[,grepl("DEM_04",  colnames(df))],df[,grepl("DEM_05f", colnames(df))],df[,grepl("DEM_05m", colnames(df))])

GenStatus[GenStatus == "a"] <- "a" # Canadian & American
GenStatus[GenStatus == "j"] <- "j" # Doesn't know
GenStatus[GenStatus != "a" & !is.na(GenStatus) & GenStatus !="j"] <- "b" # Others

colnames(GenStatus)
#Fusion of columns
Col <- c(1,6,11)
GenStatus <- cbind(apply( GenStatus[,Col] , 1 , paste , collapse = "" ),apply( GenStatus[,Col+1] , 1 , paste , collapse = "" ),
            apply( GenStatus[,Col+2] , 1 , paste , collapse = "" ),apply( GenStatus[,Col+3] , 1 , paste , collapse = "" ),
            apply( GenStatus[,Col+4] , 1 , paste , collapse = "" ))
GenStatus[GenStatus %in% c("jaj","aaj","aja","ajj","jaa","jba","jbb","jjj","jab","jbj","jjb","jja")] <- "4" ## Don't know
GenStatus[GenStatus %in% c("NANANA")] <- NA # Not available
GenStatus[GenStatus %in% c("aaa")] <- "3" # Third
GenStatus[GenStatus %in% c("aab", "aba", "abb", "abj", "ajb")] <- "2" #Second
GenStatus[GenStatus %in% c("bja","bbj","baj", "bba", "bbb", "bjb", "bjj", "bab", "baa")] <- "1" # FIRST
  ```

## SURPS — Substance Use Risk Profile Scale

- **SURPS_AS** — Anxiety sensitivity Score
  ```r
  df$SURPS_08 + df$SURPS_10 + df$SURPS_14 + df$SURPS_18 + df$SURPS_21
  ```

- **SURPS_NT** — Negative thinking Score
  ```r
  df$SURPS_17 + 30 - df$SURPS_01 - df$SURPS_04 - df$SURPS_07 - df$SURPS_13 - df$SURPS_20 - df$SURPS_23
  ```

- **SURPS_IMP** — Impulsivity Score
  ```r
  df$df$SURPS_02 + df$SURPS_05 + df$SURPS_11 + df$SURPS_15 + df$SURPS_22
  ```

- **SURPS_SS** — Sensation seeking Score
  ```r
  df$SURPS_03 + df$SURPS_06 + df$SURPS_09 + df$SURPS_12 + df$SURPS_16 + df$SURPS_19
  ```

- **ZSURPS_NT_School** — NT z score with school mean
  ```r
  ((df$SURPS_NT-df$SURPS_NT_mean)/df$SURPS_NT_sd)
  ```

- **ZSURPS_AS_School** — AS z score with school mean
  ```r
  ((df$SURPS_AS-df$SURPS_AS_mean)/df$SURPS_AS_sd)
  ```

- **ZSURPS_IMP_School** — IMP z score with school mean
  ```r
  ((df$SURPS_IMP-df$SURPS_IMP_mean)/df$SURPS_IMP_sd)
  ```

- **ZSURPS_SS_School** — SS z score with school mean
  ```r
  ((df$SURPS_SS-df$SURPS_SS_mean)/df$SURPS_SS_sd)
  ```

- **ZSURPS_NT_Total** — NT z score with sample mean
  ```r
  ((df$SURPS_NT-mean(df$SURPS_NT,na.rm=TRUE))/sd(df$SURPS_NT,na.rm=TRUE))
  ```

- **ZSURPS_AS_Total** — AS z score with sample mean
  ```r
  ((df$SURPS_AS-mean(df$SURPS_AS,na.rm=TRUE))/sd(df$SURPS_NT,na.rm=TRUE))
  ```

- **ZSURPS_IMP_Total** — IMP z score with sample mean
  ```r
  ((df$SURPS_IMP-mean(df$SURPS_IMP,na.rm=TRUE))/sd(df$SURPS_NT,na.rm=TRUE))
  ```

- **ZSURPS_SS_Total** — SS z score with sample mean
  ```r
  ((df$SURPS_SS-mean(df$SURPS_SS,na.rm=TRUE))/sd(df$SURPS_NT,na.rm=TRUE))
  ```

- **SURPS_echelle_TotalPenseesNegatives** — Negative thinking Score
  ```r
  df$SURPS_17 + 30 -df$SURPS_01 - df$SURPS_04 - df$SURPS_07 - df$SURPS_13 - df$SURPS_20 - df$SURPS_23
  ```

- **SURPS_echelle_TotalAnxiete** — Anxiety sensitivity Score
  ```r
  df$SURPS_08 + df$SURPS_10 + df$SURPS_14 + df$SURPS_18 + df$SURPS_21
  ```

- **SURPS_echelle_TotalImpulsivite** — Impulsivity Score
  ```r
  df$SURPS_02 + df$SURPS_05 + df$SURPS_11 + df$SURPS_15 + df$SURPS_22
  ```

- **SURPS_echelle_TotalSensationsFortes** — Sensation seeking Score
  ```r
  df$SURPS_03 + df$SURPS_06 + df$SURPS_09 + df$SURPS_12 + df$SURPS_16 + df$SURPS_19
  ```
